run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with the mailing list CC'd
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with a custom --cc flag to add extra reviewers to the patch upload
review_main: review the main function that wraps upload.py and ensures the GTest group is CC'd on every patch
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional command-line flags beyond --cc for patch uploads
summarize_upload_gtest: summarize the upload_gtest.py script that wraps upload.py and auto-CCs the googletestframework mailing list
